name: WeaveSync SCADA Zero-Mock Industrial Overhaul (Strict UI Freeze)
description: Production-grade backend, firmware, and anti-slop overhaul for Ali Haider Industries with STRICT UI FREEZE: preserving dark header, #e8ebf0 canvas, cards, typography, and layout, while eradicating all mock data, fake controls, and vibecoded giveaways.

userStories.title: Backend Ingestion, Dual Transport & Auto-Registration
acceptanceCriteria: Zod validation on /api/ingest/v1/batch, /api/operator/declare-stop, and /api/operator/configure-loom
Constant-time x-weavesync-key comparison with crypto.timingSafeEqual
Replay attack prevention with msgId deduplication and monotonic seq checking
Dual transport: persist to in-memory local store and Supabase (with timeout guard), serving /api/live/state
Hardware auto-registration upon valid authenticated packet with MAC deviceId
Real connectivity tracking: ONLINE (<15s), STALE (15-60s), OFFLINE (>60s with RPM 0)
Rate limiting on ingestion and operator endpoints

userStories.title: Harden WT32-ETH01 Firmware
acceptanceCriteria: totalPicks initialized to 0 on boot, transmitting incremental picksDelta per interval with monotonic seq
Read real hardware MAC ETH.macAddress() as deviceId in all payloads
Strict safe non-strapping pins: GPIO 4 (STRT), 32 (PP), 33 (WD), 14 (FD), never touching GPIO 0, 2, 12, 15
Clean hardware PCNT counter on GPIO 32 without double-counting ISR conflict
#ifndef PHY macros before #include <ETH.h>
5-second heartbeat + immediate edge state push with x-weavesync-key

userStories.title: Zero-Mock Frontend & Strict UI Freeze (Preserve Visual Look)
acceptanceCriteria: Keep exact dark header (bg-[#1e293b]), #e8ebf0 canvas, card styling, typography, and component structure strictly as-is
Delete createInitialLoomState and 36-loom hardcoded array; looms state starts strictly empty ({}) until hardware connects
Honest empty state when 0 looms connected: 'No Looms Connected' with live endpoint URL and pulsing listening indicator
Replace fake LOCAL/CLOUD toggle with single read-only status pill (Cloud Live, Local LAN, Disconnected)
Remove fake Pilot Controls drawer and fake + Commission Loom modal
Top KPI strip with 4 clean cards (Fleet Efficiency, Looms Running, Active Stoppages, Shift Output), delete fake Shed Climate
Machine cards show clean real metrics with live stop stopwatch and Log Stop Reason dialog (7 codes)
Machine detail strictly read-only; Hardware Pin Inspector shows only real pin telemetry ('No pin telemetry reported' if none)
Delete fake Huawei SUN2000 Solar chart; honest empty state on /analytics when no shift records exist

userStories.title: Anti-Slop & Web Quality Compliance
acceptanceCriteria: Zero emojis anywhere in the UI (replace with Lucide icons)
Zero duplicate icons (+ +, ⚠️ ⚠️)
Zero developer jargon ('Section 11 Verified Formulas', 'CEO pitch', 'Edge Gateway Bus', 'Mock Bus', 'PoE-Lite', 'LDL+BICOM_ETH')
Global fleet efficiency = true (sumRunMs / sumObservedMs) * 100 across connected looms only (shows — when 0 connected)
Clocks and shifts locked strictly to Asia/Karachi (Intl.DateTimeFormat) with zero hydration warnings
Custom 404 page (src/app/not-found.tsx) and error boundary (src/app/error.tsx)
Strict security headers in next.config.ts (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CORS, productionBrowserSourceMaps: false)
Zero dead links (href='#') and zero console errors

cd edge-gateway && npx tsc --noEmit passes with exit code 0
npm run verify-pilot passes end-to-end with real test packets
Browser testing via Playwright/Chrome DevTools MCP verifies empty state and zero console errors
Multi-lens CodeRabbit review completed and all criteria passing
